headline: Egypt Plans Solar Power Expansion for 7,000 Industrial Factories
summary: Egypt is expanding solar power capacity to supply 7,000 factories as part of its targets to generate 42% of electricity from renewables by 2030 and 65% by 2040.
why: Egypt is North Africa's largest economy and relies on fossil fuels, mainly natural gas and petroleum, for approximately 87% of its electricity generation.
